name: Distribution Partner API
description:
Unified API for managing distribution partner accounts (community and individual), product access configuration, content libraries, live events, embed links, and Coro music content.
## Authentication All endpoints require a Bearer JWT token passed in the `Authorization` header. Coro endpoints additionally require the `CoroApiAccess` role.
## Content Library Hierarchy
Library > Catalog > Collection > Record

## Archetypes
Content is organized by archetype. Valid archetype route values:
`spiro`, `discoverlive`, `stageaccess`, `zinnia`, `memorylane`, `srtechconnect`

## Scoping
Most Content Library endpoints accept optional `communityId` or `individualId`
query parameters to scope results to a specific distribution partner community
or individual. These are mutually exclusive.

## Pagination
List endpoints support cursor-free pagination via `page` and `resultsPerPage` query parameters.
